build.description: Rebuild everything this stack runs, even what hasn't changed.

no-build.description: Start without building, even when a build output is missing.

web.description: Only when you change the Web SDK (@beamable/sdk) or the portal toolkit (@beamable/portal-toolkit): builds them from BeamableProduct, serves them from a local npm registry and installs them in the extensions instead of the released versions, again on every save. Not needed for portal, extension or service work.

no-logs.description: Don't forward logs to Grafana. Terminal and files only.

full.description: Full-stack work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts, all Scala services, the portal and its extensions, all on this machine.

backend.description: Backend work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts and all Scala services. No portal.

csharp-portal.description: C# and portal work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts, the Scala services they call and the ones needed to log in, the portal and its extensions.

portal-extensions.description: Portal and extension work: the portal and its extensions against the dev backend. Nothing else runs on this machine.

web-dev.description: Web SDK and toolkit work: the local package registry, your SDK and toolkit builds, the portal and its extensions, against the dev backend.

non-publish.description: Type-check loop: build the packages, never publish them or point the extensions at them.

remote.description: Microservice and extension work on a remote realm: this workspace's microservices and portal extensions, registered against dev and used from the hosted portal.

native-libs.description: Native library work: builds the notification libraries for Android, and for iOS on a Mac with Xcode, into the Unity, Unity.Web, React Native and Unreal packages. Nothing else runs.

ios.description: Only the iOS frameworks (macOS with Xcode).

rn-sample.description: React Native sample work: the backend on this machine and the sample on a connected Android phone or emulator, pointed at the local realm. The native library is rebuilt when its sources have uncommitted changes.

rn: app on emulator.label: React Native sample on the emulator

rn: app on device.label: React Native sample on a phone

rn: browser.label: React Native sample in a browser

emulator.description: On the toolchain's Android emulator, started first (installed on first use, about 3 GB).

device.description: On a phone connected over USB or Wi-Fi, reaching this machine at its LAN address.

browser.description: In a browser (Expo web), with no Android build.
